options.name: all_ip_addresses
options.description:
All routable IP addresses configured on any interface will be added
to DNS

options.name: basedn
options.description: The basedn of the IPA server (of the form dc=example,dc=com)

options.name: ca_enabled
options.description: Whether the Certificate Authority is enabled or not

options.name: dns_over_tls
options.description: Configure DNS over TLS

options.name: dnsok
options.description: The installer dnsok setting

options.name: domain
options.description: Primary DNS domain of the IPA deployment

options.name: enable_dns_updates
options.description:
Configures the machine to attempt dns updates when the ip address
changes

options.name: fixed_primary
options.description: Configure sssd to use fixed server as primary IPA server

options.name: hostname
options.description: Fully qualified name of this host

options.name: ip_addresses
options.description: List of Master Server IP Addresses

options.name: krb_name
options.description: The krb5 config file name

options.name: mkhomedir
options.description: Create home directories for users on their first login

options.name: no_dns_sshfp
options.description: Do not automatically create DNS SSHFP records

options.name: no_dnssec_validation
options.description: Disable DNSSEC validation for DNS over TLS

options.name: no_krb5_offline_passwords
options.description: Configure SSSD not to store user password when the server is offline

options.name: no_ssh
options.description: Do not configure OpenSSH client

options.name: no_sshd
options.description: Do not configure OpenSSH server

options.name: no_sudo
options.description: Do not configure SSSD as data source for sudo

options.name: nosssd_files
options.description: The dist of nss_ldap or nss-pam-ldapd files if sssd is disabled

options.name: on_master
options.description: Whether the configuration is done on the master or not

options.name: permit
options.description: Disable access rules by default, permit all access

options.name: preserve_sssd
options.description: Preserve old SSSD configuration if possible

options.name: principal
options.description: User Principal allowed to promote replicas and join IPA realm

options.name: realm
options.description: Kerberos realm name of the IPA deployment

options.name: request_cert
options.description: Request certificate for the machine

options.name: selinux_works
options.description: True if selinux status check passed

options.name: servers
options.description: Fully qualified name of IPA servers to enroll to

options.name: subid
options.description: Configure SSSD as data source for subid

options.name: subject_base
options.description:
The certificate subject base (default O=<realm-name>).
RDNs are in LDAP order (most specific RDN first).
